batting.name: K Goel
batting.dismissal: c CH Gayle b I Sharma

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b SC Ganguly

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b VS Malik

balls.text: low full toss on the off, mistimes a swing wide of midwicket
they steal a bye, bowled short on middle and he tried to dab it past the keeper, missed and McCullum's under-arm flick was inaccurate
in the blockhole outside off this time, dug out towards long-on
full and wide, too wide and Jayawardene wisely lets it go to earn the call
full toss outside off, made room and sliced it behind point for a couple more, important runs these, they've got past 150
that's sailed into the stands, meaty half-volley on the off and he smashed it well over deep midwicket, deserved to go but he executed it brilliantly
superb shot, dropped it short outside off and Jayawardene walked across to pull it powerfully over short fine, landed just inside the ropes, struck it on the half-volley
yorker outside off, dug out to point, was slightly expensive compared to the others but didn't really disappoint in his first full spell in this tournament
cracked down the ground to long-off, gets a single
in the slot and has a swing but misses, fraction full outside off but he fails to make contact
bangs it short on middle, it's too high as Chawla doesn't have to duck much, given a wide
bowls it on a length outside off and he walks across, bends low to paddle it fine, gets an inside edge onto his pads and gets a single wide of point
well played, quicker, at 133 kmph, dropped it short, made room and upper-cut that over the keeper and well wide of third man for a boundary
slower ball bowled full on middle and off, dug out to point
good over, banged in short and he made room to cut that past the keeper, missed, only four off it
on middle and off, defended solidly to cover and wisely decides against the run
short on leg stump, walks across and fends it away behind the keeper, Henriques fails to back up a throw from McCulum and concedes an overthrow
full on the off, driven down to long-off for a single

got onto him quick although a speed of 123.7 kmph doesn't seem too fast, tried to clear midwicket off that short ball, was a little too high, got the top edge and McCullum didn't have to move much to complete the catch
inswinger landing on a length on the off, driven through the line to long-off
on middle, gets forward and dabs it wide of midwicket
short and wide, tries to cut it past point, gets a thick edge towards short fine
tossed up on leg stump and turned back in, he got forward to work it away but was rapped on the pads, big shout but not upheld, we need a replay
gets forward and turns it away wide of midwicket
dipping it into the batsman, full on the off, dug out to point
poor ball first up, drops it short and Jayawardene cuts it away firmly behind point to get his first boundary
length ball on the off, bowled at a decent pace of 135.3 kmph, punched to cover
full on the off, pushed wide of cover for a single

much quicker this time, bowled at 135.1 kmph, he tried to swat that past the on-side field but mistimed it straight to Yashpal Singh at deep midwicket, took it cleanly this time, clutching it to his chest
dragged it short on middle and Yuvraj had no trouble dismissing it to the deep square-leg boundary, got forward and pulled it away with ease
short of a length outside off, tapped to third man to give his more explosive partner the strike
full on middle, driven down to long-off
short of a length on middle, is not able to do much with it
short and wide, the movement takes it further away as he goes for a mighty pull

massive, length ball on the off stump and he got under it nicely, timing his loft beautifully to comfortably clear long-on, Harsha Bhogle, surprisingly, missed out saying "that's a DLF maximum". Is he in for a reprimand now?
does so this time, similar delivery but he plays it much straighter, slapping it hard past the bowler to beat long-on
short and wide, tried to heave that over midwicket but failed to connect
fired it wide of leg and Jayawardene tried to clip it fine, McCullum collected well but missed the stumps on the first attempt, the batsman though managed to have his foot rooted in the crease

run out, pulled in front of square towards midwicket where Chopra slides and returns a throw back to the keeper, Sanga is more than halfway down the pitch but Yuvraj doesn't respond, he's found miles short of his ground as McCullum collects a slightly wayward throw to clip the bails
makes room and Ishant chases him, drags it short and Sanga pulls it down to long-on
trying to improvise, this is a good over, makes room to help it on its way over the keeper and a widish third man but misses
short, bowled at 135 kmph on middle, clatters it to cover who's positioned perfectly
good stuff, bowled on a good length and got it to move away as Sanga came forward to drive it on the up
much fuller, got back and attempted to smash it over mid-off but missed
short outside off, makes room and cuts it over point for a couple
on middle and off, makes room and chips it wide of the bowler towards long-off, end of a good spell
on the stumps, waited for it and chopped it down to third man, brings up the 100, they've recovered well due to these two
nipped back in, slightly short and he expected it to hold its line as he tried to punch that past cover, ended up getting a thick inside edge behind square
full and wide, launches into it but Ganguly's bowling to his field, though it's creamed through the off side, it finds deep cover positioned exactly for that shot
short outside off, guided down to third man
short on the off, punched down the ground to long-off
length on middle and leg, tickled behind square for a single, end of a productive over, thanks to the wides
thrown up again, takes a couple of steps and turns it wide of deep midwicket
and again, drawing him forward with the flight, he presents the full face to get long-off into action again
tossed up on middle, drives it down the ground past the bowler to long-off
gets forward and drives it wide of cover for a single
another one, poor stuff this, down the leg side again and McCullum isn't happy
much better, flighted on middle, goes through with the drive, gets a thick inside edge wide of short fine for a couple
and again, poor start, but much slower through the air so he only concedes a run
terrible, fires it in outside leg and gifts them five runs as McCullum has no chance to get behind it, atrocious
gets forward and drives it stylishly with a flourish through to deep cover
cramps him up this time, lands on the off stump and gets it to spit away, Yuvraj covers it well, getting behind it and defending it back to the bowler
shot! Long hop and it deserved to be hit, rocks back and clatters it over the deep-midwicket boundary
similar delivery but gets it much squarer, chops it down to Chopra at point who gifts them a couple, allowing it to roll through his legs
short and wide, slashes hard, gets a thick edge wide of third man, lucky but he'll take the runs, Ganguly has his hands covering his face
gets across and pulls it away to deep midwicket for a single, time for the strategy break now
Sangakkara chops it away wide of point, was just slightly short and he was onto it quickly, it's started to drizzle a bit down in Durban
gets back and drops it into the off side
short on the off, gets across and uses his wrists to tickle it wide of deep square leg for a couple

Yashpal Singh takes the catch of the tournament! Replays, though, indicate that wasn't taken cleanly, what a let down. Short on middle, seemed like a harmless delivery and he pulled it wide of deep square leg, Yashpal ran yards and timed his dive-to-the-left to perfection but grounded it with his outstretched left hand as he landed
short on middle and leg, pulled away to deep square leg
much slower, at 110.5 kmph, gets forward and respectfully dabs it into the leg side, excellent spell here from the former captain
good length outside off, slapped past a diving point for a single
slightly shorter, gets back, waits for it and turns his bat to guide that behind point
fullish again, gets forward and pushes it without much conviction, uppishly towards cover
testing line on and outside off, leans forward and defends it towards cover
length ball on the off stump, defended into the leg side, calls for a single but is sent back
gets back and taps it down to point, angling away and gets behind to open the face
pushed it slower this time, marginally short and Yuvraj pulls it away to deep square leg
good length outside off, he charges forward and tries to strike it over mid-off, gets a thick outside edge and it flies off over a towering Gayle at slip for a boundary
picked the length early but it probably didn't bounce as much as he expected, clattered it wide of long-on for a couple, brings up the 50, it's taken some effort
bouncer outside off, bowled at around 136 kmph, Yuvraj backed away from it
Short outside off, hangs his bat out to play it over a leaping point for a single, didn't clear him by much
excellent stuff, similar delivery but gets some more bounce this time, Yuvraj is taken bu surprise and plays at it awkwardly to be beaten again
beaten! Ganguly draws him forward with a good length ball outside off, Yuvraj tries to open the face and drop it on the off side but it just evades the outside edge
Dada, you beauty! Shah Rukh has a look of satisfaction on his face. Short and wide, Bopara goes for the cut, gets a thin edge straight to McCullum who takes a sharp catch standing up
on middle and off, gets forward and dabs it wide of cover for a single

the bowling change works! Meaty, length ball outside off and he slogs it well towards deep midwicket, but he doesn't time it well enough to clear the ropes as Kartik cups it standing right at the edge of the ropes, and ensures he doesn't lose his balance. Big blow that!
on middle and leg, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
he's dealt with the short one superbly so far, gets it well in front of square this time, all of his pulls have come off the front foot and this one's no different, swatted it cleanly wide of mid-on
slower one, an offcutter bowled slightly short outside off, Irfan tried to run it past the keeper, missed as it moved away from him
short and he latches onto it quickly, gets forward and pulls it away behind square, well struck
full and wide, bowled at 139 kmph, goes at it hard trying ti blaze it over cover, misses
fullish on the off stump, pushed through firmly to cover
on middle and off, nudged into the leg side for a single
slower one, bowled at 110.7 kmph, pushed through the covers for a single
full and wide, makes room and slices it over the infield on the off side for a couple more, he's done a decent job so far
that's dismissed, banged in short and pulls it away with disdain over midwicket, that was a bludgeoned
gets forward and drops it towards cover, slightly fuller

has a wild swing at it, slightly slower, a length ball outside off, planted his foot forward and slogged it to clear the deep-midwicket boundary, didn't time it as well as he would have liked, but it had enough on it to take it over the ropes
short on middle, gets back and drops it short of mid-on for a single
bowled on a length on middle and leg, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
short of a good length outside off, holding its line, Bopara lets it through
banged in short on leg stump, was quick but Pathan responded well, fending it away without a flourish to clear the infield and get it wide of fine leg for a single
lucky, and pays off, much quicker, short outside off, he got forward to pull that over midwicket, got a thick edge and it flew over slip towards the third-man boundary
fuller, a teasing line outside off and Pathan is tempted, he attempts a lethargic drive but the ball cuts away to beat the outside edge
slower one this time, an offcutter, gets forward, waits for it, opens the face to guide it down to third man
easily done, just straying in line there, angling it into the pads and he tucks it away to fine leg to keep the strike
stays rooted to the crease and taps it between mid-off and cover for a single
a touch fuller, bringing him forward, he tries to punch that through the off side without getting to the pitch, it leaves him to beat the outside edge
short and wide and he cashes in, poor delivery first up, cuts it away powerfully over point to start off in style

gone! Goel was getting a little desperate there, Ishant had done well to bog him down, landed on a good length and Goel tried to force that powerfully through the off side from the crease, was not the pitch, it took the outside edge and Gayle standing at first slip timed his jump perfectly to snap a sharp chance
back of a length, getting it to leave the left hander, Goel plays that slightly away from his body, misses
he's spoilt the over, pitched on a good length drawing him forward, Bopara leans into it and squeezes it past a diving cover, was beautifully timed
just a fraction short and he cashes in, gets forward, seizes the length early and pulls it away over square leg, first boundary of the innings
short of a good length on the off and moving back in, gets back and punches it to point
much straighter, on middle and leg, gets across and turns it to square leg, quiet start here, Dinda's done well so far
slightly slower, enough width but Bopara is not fully committed to the shot, just dabs it towards point
decent pace, starts off at 132.9 kmph, slightly short on the off, pushed through to cover off the back foot
short and wide, slashes hard from the crease, not much foot movement there, fails to connect
jagged back in and zipped right through him, he got forward to defend expecting it to hold its line but it nipped back to zip through the gate
much wider, not enough to induce Goel into playing a shot, he lets it go
beauty! Getting it to leave the batsman this time, spat away as Goel tried to prod at it, beating the edge
cramping him for room there, brought it back in after landing on a good length outside off, tapped into the off side
angling into the right hander, gets back and tickles it behind square to get off the mark
short of a length on the off, chopped down to cover off the back foot
full on the off stump, driven through the line to long-off
slightly short, got back to play it down towards cover, good over but Kolkata have their noses in front here
googly, but he spotted it, made room, got back and chopped it well behind point for a couple
short and wide, cut straight to point, good over so far
flighted on the off, tried to drive it down the ground, mistimes it and it drops dead on the pitch
on the off stump again, pushed towards cover
tossed up on the off, not quite there to cut but he manages to chop it down to point
smashed it! Slower one, bowled really short, a gift ball really and Gayle got back to dismiss it miles into the stands
shapes himself for a pull by getting his front foot across, but adjusted well to the length and cut it straight to point
probing him outside off but Gayle restrains himself here, left alone, he's been dropped twice in this innings
played it across the line, dragged it from outside off but connected well, played it wide of deep midwicket for three more
short and wide, slashed hard but missed, left him as he chased it
short on middle and off, pushed wide of cover for a single
googly again, bringing it back in from wide of the crease, dabbed in front of short fine
turned away wide of square leg for a single
pushed behind point off the back foot
driven down the ground wide of long-off
dropped, the googly deceived him there, slightly short on the off and spun away, Gayle played inside the line, got the outside edge and Sanga failed to pouch that
short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg
jagged back in, on middle and leg, tucked away behind square for a single
good length outside off, held its line, Hodge let it go
banged it short on middle, pulls it down behind square for a couple, some good running there, fine leg took a while to run in
poor ball but fetches him a wicket, short and wide, makes room to cut, gets a thick edge and Sangakkara snaps it to his right, they've broken through!
the game's slipping away from Punjab here, banged in short outside off and he charges down while making room simultaneously to upper-cut it well over third man for a big six
thrashed first ball, overpitched outside off and McCullum makes room to drive that ferociously over cover
short outside off, tries to chop it down past point but it's too close to cut, misses as it holds its line
full down the leg side, moved across to flick it fine, he missed but the umpire's  rightly called it a wide
good length on the off, goes for a blazing drive through the covers but gets a thick inside edge wide of square leg

the bowler almost did him in there, got it to move away after it pitched fullish outside off, Gayle was through with the drive a little early, got a thick outside edge between point and cover for a single

That's murdered, length ball this time and he's onto it quickly, gets to the pitch and has a mighty swing at it that takes it well into the stands over long-on, Kolkata have grabbed the advantage here
Punishment! Short on middle, gets on the front foot and pulls it with fiercely in the direction of deep square leg for a one bounce four
That's creamed, and the umpire was in the firing line. In the slot on middle and Gayle smashes it back the past the bowler, just over the umpire's head for a boundary down the ground
slower one, dabs it to the onside, looks for the single but the bowlers rushes across
Oh ho that's a crowd killer. McCullum took one step forward and square drives a flat six over cover point and into the crowd. Stunning hit! says the big screen and it is
fuller, just outside off, dragged across to the on side, going for the heave
drags it short but Gayle pulls it high and over deep midwicket. The show has begun
fullish, on the middle, dug out past the bowler
Wham! There goes Gayle. The lovely free savage swing of the bat and the ball flies over cover point
held it back a touch and it swung away sharply as Gayle let it go
getting it to leave the left hander, fullish on the off and he covers the movement well by defending it with a full face
full on the off, shuffles and drives it down to mid-on for a quick single
dropped, pretty straightforward, short on the off and it's pulled straight to Goel at midwicket to puts down a sitter, how costly will that prove?
on target, gets it on a good length on middle, defended to midwicket
full and wide and swinging away further, given a wide, struggling with his direction here, the right and left-hand combination isn't helping him
on middle and leg, turned away towards fine leg for a single
down the leg side this time, McCullum doesn't connect on an attempted glance, but it's a wide
testing line again, gets forward and blocks it towards cover
beaten! Drawing him forward by bowling it on a length outside off, prods at it but misses as it leaves him
better start this time, teasing him outside off, opens the face to play it down to third man
pushed through fuller on leg stump, at 135.5 kmph, flicked away to fine leg
short and wide, in the cutting zone but moves away as Gayle lets it go, called a wide
short of a good length on the off, bowled at 133.7 kmph, dabbed to point with an open face
short and wide, chopped wide of slip and gets a quick single, Gayle stretches to make it in
much fuller, well outside off, McCullum lets it go and it brushes his pads on the way through
short and moves back in to rap him on the pads, but it was a little too high
brought it back in, that's his strength, slightly short though and McCullum negotiates it well
